title: Auto Food
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Eats food automatically.
body:
Created by @TheEpitex YouTube channel, this mod removes the need to stop and eat.
It intelligently consumes available food from your Hotbar based on your health and food value so you can focus on exploring, fighting, and building.
